title: Eval change correlator: insights timeline and smart alert routing
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
Build an "eval change correlator" feature in Console that (1) overlays eval metric timelines with model/version/config change events and rollout metadata, (2) computes likely root-cause correlation signals between a configuration/model change and a regression in one or more eval metrics, and (3) drives smart alert routing and deduplication into Slack and PagerDuty based on correlation fingerprints and impact scope.

Background / motivation:
- Teams currently get eval regression alerts in Console but must manually inspect timelines and diffs to connect a regression to a recent config tweak, quantization change, or model rollout. This slows investigation and increases alert noise.
- We want to reduce mean time to detect + diagnose (MTTD/MTTDx) by surfacing probable causes and grouping alerts by shared root signals (same commit, same config bucket, same rollout cohort).

Goals (what success looks like):
- Product: Console shows an Eval Insights timeline with configurable overlays for model versions, routing policies, quantization profile changes, and rollout batches.
- Correlation: For any alerting regression, Console returns a ranked list of candidate changes (commit id, config id, release tag) with a confidence score and basic stats (delta, p-value).
- Alerting: Slack and PagerDuty notifications use correlation fingerprints to dedupe/route alerts: e.g., route high-confidence model-rollout regressions to platform SRE/channel A, low-confidence to product owners, and collapse multiple alerts that share the same fingerprint.
- Coverage: Feature initially supports top 5 eval metrics (accuracy, exact match, rouge-l, bertscore, hallucination rate) and model/config changes captured by our deploy metadata and SDK telemetry.
- Safety: No PII is exported to external integrations; internal links go to Console.

Scope and non-goals:
- In-scope: timeline UI, backend correlation scoring prototype (heuristic + bootstrap statistical test), alert fingerprinting, Slack/PagerDuty integration wiring, basic dedupe rules, per-route routing rules in Console.
- Out-of-scope for this ticket: full Bayesian causality analysis, automatic rollbacks, per-customer custom thresholds (follow-up ticket).

Design proposal (high level):
1) Data model: add "event" stream that combines existing eval result points (metric, timestamp, dataset) with change events (deploys, config updates, quantization profile changes) annotated with metadata: author, changelist id, rollout cohort, model-id, model-variant, and optional customer-scoped flag.
2) Correlation engine: heuristic pipeline that computes: (a) temporal proximity score (how soon after change the metric drifted), (b) magnitude score (size of metric delta relative to baseline variance), (c) cohort overlap score (was the rollout targeting the evaluation’s traffic cohort?), and (d) repeatability signal (did multiple evals see the same pattern). Combine into normalized confidence [0..1]. Use permutation test to estimate a p-value for the delta where appropriate.
3) Fingerprinting: create stable fingerprint string for a change event using (change-type, model-id, model-version, config-hash, rollout-id). All alerts derived from correlated regressions that map to the same fingerprint are grouped and deduped.
4) UI: timeline view with colored bands for deploys and changes, hover cards that show change metadata, a correlated-causes sidebar with confidence bars and suggested next steps (run targeted eval set, revert quantization profile, promote fallback model). Allow manual mark-as-root-cause.
5) Alerts: add routing rules editor in Console to map fingerprint tags and confidence thresholds to Slack channels and PagerDuty services. Implement a dedupe window (default 30m) and a suppression mechanism for repeated low-confidence noisy signals.

User stories:
- As an SRE, when a significant BLEU drop occurs, I want Console to surface the model rollout that most likely caused it and auto-route to the SRE PagerDuty if confidence >= 0.8.
- As an ML engineer, I want correlated updates surfaced alongside the eval so I can prioritize rollbacks or PRs.
- As a product owner, I want multiple minor regressions that stem from the same release fingerprint to be grouped into one conversation in Slack.

Acceptance criteria (must meet to close):
- Backend pipeline stores change events and links them to eval datapoints in the new event index.
- Correlation engine returns candidate causes with confidence and basic stats for at least 5 metric types.
- Timeline UI displays overlays for changes and highlights correlated candidates. 
- Slack notifications include a fingerprint tag and a Console link; matching fingerprint alerts within dedupe window collapse into one thread.
- PagerDuty integration can be targeted by routing rules and respects dedupe keys to avoid duplicate incidents.
- Unit and integration tests for fingerprinting logic and confidence calc exist with >85% coverage on new modules.

Implementation notes / engineering tasks (candidate sub-issues):
- ENG-xxxx: event ingestion pipeline extension (capture deploy/config metadata) and schema migration for event index.
- ENG-xxxx: correlation engine prototype (stat tests + heuristic combiner).
- ENG-xxxx: fingerprint generator and dedupe key service.
- ENG-xxxx: Notifications adapter changes for Slack/PagerDuty (include fingerprint in payload, support grouping).
- DES-xxx: timeline UX mockups and hover interactions + routing rules editor mocks.
- PM tasks: docs for runbook, alert playbooks, and user opt-in guidance.

Rollout plan / risk mitigation:
- Phase 1 (beta): internal and early-access customers only. Alerts default to Slack #evals-alpha and PagerDuty test service. Manual opt-in from teams.
- Phase 2: wider rollout with per-org routing rules and default thresholds. Introduce rate limits and suppression for noisy signals.
- Rollback plan: allow turning off correlation+dedupe in Console per-org and revert to raw eval alerts.

Telemetry & success metrics:
- Reduce number of distinct alert threads for root-cause events by 40% in beta orgs.
- Mean time to triage for correlated regressions reduced by 30%.
- False positive routing (PD pages sent with confidence >=0.8 but not actually root-cause) < 10%.

Privacy & security considerations:
- Fingerprints are deterministic but designed not to include customer data.
- External payloads to Slack/PagerDuty must not contain raw eval inputs or user PII. Links point back to Console which enforces SSO.

Documentation & runbooks:
- Add Console help article: "Understanding correlated eval alerts and routing".
- Add runbook templates for SREs and ML engineers for investigating fingerprinted regressions.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- How to handle correlated signals that cross multiple small deploys in a short window? (We propose scoring by weighted recency and cohort overlap.)
- Should dedupe be aggressive (merge different metrics under one fingerprint) or conservative? Initial plan: conservative by default, allow admins to widen grouping.
- Statistical tests vs heuristics: start with heuristics + permutation test fallback, revisit with causal inference research (follow-up).

2026-03-11 - Maya Chen (Design): Will provide timeline mockups and routing rules UX next week. Suggest adding a manual 'mark as root cause' button so teams can teach the correlator over time.
